SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q16. The area of a quadrant of a circle with circumference 22 cm is:
(a) 7.725 cm²
(b) 9.625 cm²
(c) 12.25 cm²
(d) 14.5 cm²

Answer / Solution:
Circumference 2πr = 22
2 × (22/7) × r = 22 => r = 3.5 cm
Quadrant area = (1/4)πr^2 = (1/4) × (22/7) × 3.5 × 3.5 = 9.625 cm²
Answer: (b) 9.625 cm²
